nl.title: Eigen (custom) SSL-certificaat uploaden in CyberPanel
nl.excerpt: Eigen (custom) SSL-certificaat uploaden in CyberPanel: praktische handleiding in CyberPanel, met stappen, controles en wanneer je TripleZero iT support inschakelt.
nl.bodyHtml:
Voor OV/EV of corporate certs upload je certificate + private key (+ chain) in CyberPanel in plaats van Let’s Encrypt.

Stappen

  1. Genereer CSR indien de CA dat eist (of gebruik geleverde key).
  2. Ontvang certificaat en intermediate/chain.
  3. Upload in SSL → custom / hostname selecteren.
  4. Herlaad OpenLiteSpeed indien nodig; test SSL Labs of browser.

Let op: Plak nooit private keys in tickets of chat — gebruik beveiligd uploadkanaal.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld hostname, CyberPanel-URL en wat je precies ziet (foutmelding of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: SSL voor mail; HTTPS forceren.

en.bodyHtml:
This guide covers Upload your own (custom) SSL certificate in CyberPanel. You work in CyberPanel, focusing on upload, own, custom — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to CyberPanel
  • Focus of this article: upload, own, custom
  • Recent backup or snapshot

Steps

  1. Open CyberPanel and look specifically for settings around upload, own, custom.
  2. Select the correct website in CyberPanel.
  3. Open SSL, DNS, Email, File Manager or Backup — focused on upload.
  4. Apply the own update; purge OLS cache if the site shows stale content.
  5. Check Error Logs if you get 500/white screen after the change.
  6. Rotate credentials tied to upload, own, custom if abuse was possible.
  7. Schedule monitoring or a follow-up check.

Verify

  • Result for upload, own, custom matches “Upload your own (custom) SSL certificate in CyberPanel”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside upload own custom
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get upload, own, custom right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if upload, own, custom touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: CyberPanel, backups, tickets.
